President Trump signs the Graham Russia and Iran Sanctions Act, levying severe economic pressure and up to 100% tariffs on oil buyers.
Evidence: H.R. 5334 signed, 100% tariffs authorized, Ukraine support
#Aletheia #Geopolitics

The new legislation aggressively targets Russian and Iranian energy sectors to curb sanctions evasion and support Ukraine.

While penalizing adversaries, the sweeping secondary tariff authorities concentrate immense executive leverage and economic friction globally.

The sanctions act delivers targeted pressure on Moscow, but expands unilateral tariff powers with complex economic fallout.

President Trump signed the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 after congressional approval, authorizing tariffs up to 100% on nations purchasing Russian energy.

The Bright Side:
It provides a concrete statutory lever to punish sanction evasion and support Ukraine's defense without direct military escalation.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing legislative intent (WHO benefits) with broader economic fallout (WHERE trade shifts occur). The bait-and-switch trades targeted deterrence for sweeping tariff powers.

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors deploy hardline economic statecraft as a Smart Selfish Maneuver, wrapping geopolitical leverage in national security pretexts while externalizing market costs onto global trade partners.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Executive tariff concentration yields high systemic friction.

The Unavoidable Truth: Statutory sanctions restrict Russian and Iranian energy revenues.

The Unavoidable Lie: Sweeping secondary tariffs carry zero collateral economic costs for allies.

Alethekanon:
Legislative deterrence relies on blunt economic coercion, trading multilateral stability for concentrated executive leverage 🌐

Awwthekanon:
When nations clash through economic walls, the burden ultimately ripples outward to ordinary families striving for daily bread and stability.

Brothekanon:
Washington just dropped a massive tariff hammer on anyone buying Russian oil, so get ready for some serious global market turbulence.

Spirithekanon:
"Dishonest scales are an abomination to the Lord, but a just weight is his delight" Proverbs 11:1 PASS
True economic justice requires transparent weights rather than blunt coercive leverage.

Actual Article Body:
President Donald Trump signed a bill into law on Friday that imposes a new round of sanctions against Russia amid its war with Ukraine.

The new law, formally known as the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, targets Russia’s energy sector by authorizing the president to impose up to 100% tariffs on countries purchasing Russian oil and natural gas. It sanctions Russian President Vladimir Putin and other Russian officials and entities as well, and also extends sanctions on Iran’s energy and weapons sectors.
